added: Each named phrase of an English dance has a Beats to the bar field beside its Bars, so a tune that changes meter, such as an A in 3/4 and a B in 6/8, can be set up without typing the phrase structure by hand. The dance is then counted in bars phrase by phrase.
changed: Editing an English dance's Meter sets every named phrase's beats to the bar only when the Meter now states other beats to the bar than it did. A word added after "3/4", or a Meter that names two meters such as "3/4 and 6/8", no longer resets the beats you set for each phrase.
